findings.message: Root element has class="tz" and is styled by 1 rule(s) keyed off that class (e.g. .tz). At render, every sub-composition rule is scoped to [data-composition-id="s1-hook"] <selector>, so a selector whose leftmost part is the ROOT's own class becomes a descendant selector that cannot match the scoped element itself. Since #1886 the producer preserves the authored root as an inner wrapper, so this no longer renders the scene unstyled, but #root is the shape the scoper special-cases and the registry blocks model. Use it so preview, render, and Studio agree.
findings.fixHint: Give the root id="root" and style it with `#root { ... }` plus plain descendant selectors (`.kicker`, `#hero`). The runtime already scopes each sub-composition by data-composition-id, so a class namespace on the root is redundant.
